audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and first item were given to Yorick or Skill while the whys[] beside them describe Graves controlling every trade, and levels 4-5 read Yorick while its own line calls the stage 'roughly even'.
audit.why: Graves owns this lane until you out-grind him with two items — 51.33% over 4009 games comes from the late rows, not the early ones. The mirror set rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 to Graves on its side.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 to Graves at 3/10, row 3 to Skill at 5/10, row 6 raised to 7/10, as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: The spike shape is right: his first item, your two-item grind.
audit.corrected: Kept; End of the Line's 13s-to-6s cooldown range and Quickdraw's 16s at rank 1 added so the advice has numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Buckshot' is not a Graves ability. It appears six times as his Q. His Q is End of the Line. The resist buff from Quickdraw is called True Grit, and the page describes Quickdraw as an ability you wait out rather than one his own autos refund.
audit.why: Same class of error as the Brand 'Ares of Blaze' case. Worse, the real decisive interaction was never stated: End of the Line detonates on colliding with terrain, and Dark Procession creates terrain — your own cage triggers his shell early, right next to you.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout, True Grit named, the cooldown refund stated instead of a flat wait, and the wall-detonation interaction written into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every line said 'engage when Quickdraw is down' without saying how long down is, or that hitting you with basic attacks lowers it.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but refunds on hit, so a nominal window can be gone before you commit.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Quickdraw dashes and stacks True Grit resists, and his autos refund its 16s. Commit once it runs.

edits.before: Graves out-trades you at level 1 with Buckshot and his double-AA passive before ghouls matter.
edits.after: Graves out-trades level 1 with End of the Line and a 4-bullet shotgun passive before ghouls matter.

edits.before: By level 3 Buckshot's cooldown is low enough that he still controls every trade.
edits.after: By level 3 End of the Line is down to 9.5s and he still controls every trade.

edits.before: Graves shreds your ghouls and health with Buckshot (Q) and the double-tap AA, so don't stack trades — use ghouls only as chip and farm with Q resets behind your wall.
edits.after: Graves shreds ghouls and health with End of the Line (Q) and his 4-bullet shotgun, so don't stack trades — use ghouls as chip and farm with Last Rites behind your wall.

edits.before: Even with Maiden up, Graves can Quickdraw (E) dash out of the wall and burst your ghouls with Buckshot, so summon R only when he's already committed and E is down.
edits.after: Even with Maiden up, Quickdraw dashes him clear and refunds its own cooldown off every auto, so summon R only once he has committed and those 16s are genuinely running.

edits.before: His first-item spike (Q shred plus armor from Quickdraw stacks) lets him win extended fights, so keep pushing and pressuring rather than dueling him head-on.
edits.after: His first-item spike — End of the Line plus the True Grit resists Quickdraw stacks — wins extended fights, so keep pushing and pressuring rather than dueling head-on.

edits.before: Graves dominates levels 1-3: Buckshot (Q) plus his two-round autos out-trade you hard and clear your ghouls faster than you can stack them, so just farm and never fight into full cooldowns.
edits.after: Graves dominates levels 1-3: End of the Line (Q) plus his shotgun autos out-trade you hard and clear ghouls faster than you stack them, so farm and never fight into a loaded gun.

edits.before: It stays his through the mid-game — level 4-5 is a brief skill window where a good wall can punish a whiffed Q, but at 6 his Quickdraw (E) mobility lets him slip your Dark Procession and re-burst, keeping him ahead.
edits.after: It stays his through the mid-game — 4-5 is a brief skill window where a wall punishes a whiffed End of the Line, but at 6 Quickdraw slips Dark Procession and re-bursts. His Q also detonates on terrain, so a badly placed cage sets it off on you.

edits.before: Wall him only after Quickdraw (E) is spent
edits.after: Wall once Quickdraw's 16s is truly running

edits.before: Shred ghouls and HP with Buckshot (Q) and double-AA
edits.after: Shred ghouls with End of the Line and shotgun autos

notes: 'Buckshot' is a fabricated/outdated Q name appearing six times here — grep the dataset for it across all Graves matchups. New finding not in the mirror: End of the Line detonates on colliding with terrain and Dark Procession creates terrain, so your own cage can trigger his shell at point-blank range. Levels 4-5 set to Skill following the packet and the existing prose; the mirror put that row on Graves — see questionsForUser.
